title: Special Provisions for Applying Certain Underlying Regulations to MX Districts
previewText: For the purposes of determining the applicability of underlying adjacency regulations to zoning lots adjoining or within close proximity to district boundaries, M1 Districts paired with Residence Districts shall be considered C6 Districts.
